_about: Batch D (Oct 20) tune data. Note names are lower-case with octave (c4 = middle C = MIDI 60); every note is in c4..c6 and in the family key's major pentatonic. beats = note lengths in beats. Samples: music/notes/<family>_<note>.ogg (# -> s, e.g. slyte_fs4).

echo_it_back._about: Echo It Back (Batch F, music Part B piece 1). Tunes are scale degrees of the family key (song format v1, see songbook.schema in echoback.js): n = [[degree 1-7, octave, ticks @ 12/beat]]. Matching compares the degree order only (timing ignored). Never more than 4 distinct notes in a tune. pads = the 8 staircase pads (same set + layout as the future jam pad); unlock = pads added at each tier (tier = glowNow(), 5 counts as 4).

v2._about: Batch G (Echo It Back v2): round = 5 matches (same or close; a miss neither counts nor resets); 10 tunes without 5 = soft stop. Start length by age band, ramp only after a round with all 5 matched first try, cap 16. Past 8 notes: 4-note phrases (ABA up to 12, AABA above), echoed phrase by phrase, 1 slip (close) a phrase. After 16: +5% tempo a round. Stickers at lengths + the 3rd speed round. Lengths are dots on screen, never numbers.

songbook._about: Ancient Echoes (Music School step 2). Built by tools/build_songbook.py from tools/songbook_src/<fam>/<id>.txt (Cole). echo = Song v2 (the real hook the Echo sings, acc = half-steps), child = Song v1 phrases on the family pads. Only prov_status ok ships.
